ops.title: Running operations
ops.none: No operation is running right now.

kill.title: Kill this operation?
kill.description: The server stops the {{op}} on {{ns}}. Its client gets an error; work done so far is not rolled back unless it runs in a transaction.

profiler.title: Slow queries (profiler)
profiler.readOnly: Read-only connections cannot change the profiler.
profiler.unavailable: The profiler is not available here: {{message}}
profiler.off: The profiler is off for this database. Choose “Slow operations” to record queries slower than the threshold.
profiler.empty: Nothing recorded yet. Slow operations appear here as they happen.

hints.wasteful: reads far more than it returns

profiler.detailsHint: As recorded by the profiler. A plan without IXSCAN, or many more documents read than returned, usually means a missing index: open the query in its collection and run Explain for a suggestion.
